justifications.fit: the frozenset at imas_ambix/agent/engine_metrics.py:259-267 and the predicate at :660-667 match the surrounding table-and-resolver idiom and no added name, comment or docstring carries a plan label, a version suffix or changelog prose, so the one blemish is that docstring's own pointer.
